name: Hashnode
label: Hashnode Public GraphQL API
description: Official Hashnode GraphQL at https://gql.hashnode.com via OfficialApiNode. POST entire input JSON (query + variables). Bearer personal_access_token. As of 2026-05-13, GraphQL queries and mutations against a publication require Hashnode Pro (https://hashnode.com/changelog/2026-05-13-graphql-api-paid-access). Never log the PAT. Official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Hashnode GraphQL POST. Send query plus publicationId/title/contentMarkdown (mapped into variables.input) or a variables object. Do not put personal_access_token here. Example: {"operation":"post_publish","query":"mutation …","publicationId":"…","title":"Hi","contentMarkdown":"# Hi"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: post_publish | post_get | draft_create | publication_get. Same HTTP path for all.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Non-empty GraphQL document (query / mutation / subscription). Optional variables object may ride alongside bodyMap fields. Cover images: set coverImageOptions inside variables (no cover_image INPUT field). Example: query { __typename }.

schema.label: Publication id
schema.description: PublishPostInput / CreateDraftInput publicationId (ObjectId). post_publish / draft_create. Example: 65a8e6b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: Post or draft title. post_publish / draft_create. Example: Shipping GraphQL in production.

schema.label: Markdown
schema.description: Post body as Markdown (contentMarkdown). post_publish / draft_create.

schema.label: Slug
schema.description: URL slug. post_publish / draft_create / post_get. Generated from title when omitted on publish.

schema.label: Tags
schema.description: PublishPostInput.tags — list of {slug, name?} (max 15). post_publish / draft_create. Example: [{"slug":"graphql","name":"GraphQL"}].

schema.label: Post / publication id
schema.description: GraphQL id for post_get (variables.id) or publication_get (variables.id).

schema.label: Publication host
schema.description: Publication host without scheme. post_get / publication_get. Example: blog.example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (GraphQL JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Catalog verb. All four POST / on gql.hashnode.com.

configurationParameters.label: Personal access token
configurationParameters.description: Hashnode PAT. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Default publication id
configurationParameters.description: Default Hashnode publication ObjectId when INPUT publicationId is empty. Used by post_publish / draft_create.
